photographer.name: Toki SHI
photographer.statement:
Photography is how I see the world beyond the screen.
I travel with a camera and return with stories.
photographer.bio:
Photography is my way of stepping beyond the screen and into the world.

Through landscapes and streets, I chase light, movement, and the stories they quietly hold.

I'm drawn not only to the spectacular, but to the in-between — the subtle moments that pass before most eyes can catch them.
